query: Give me this report as a nicely formatted PDF using our PowerPoint template's colors and design.
expected_behavior: Extracts a theme from the PowerPoint template with extract_theme.py (colors, fonts, logo) into a theme.json
Runs build_report.py with that theme to produce the PDF (and offers HTML/DOCX too)
Reports where the file was written; if no headless browser is present, says PDF was skipped and offers the HTML to print

query: I need this as both a Word document and a PDF, and they must look identical and on-brand.
expected_behavior: Runs build_report.py with --formats docx,pdf and the same theme so both share one design
Notes that a DOCX logo must be PNG/JPG (SVG embeds only in HTML/PDF) and falls back to the organization wordmark otherwise
Confirms both outputs use the theme's brand colors and fonts

query: Make a standardized report template so all our reports come out looking the same.
expected_behavior: Establishes a single theme.json (extracted from the brand template or hand-written from theme.example.json) to reuse across reports
Explains that the agent writes the content as Markdown and the script renders consistent HTML/PDF/DOCX from it
Keeps the theme file local (organization-specific), not committed to the public repo
